title: Ringside Sunday: DDT at Korakuen, Kōenji crates, a free night view and a Kabukichō soak

stops.name: Yamato airport delivery: suitcases to Haneda T3
stops.plan: Hand the big suitcases to Yamato (front desk or the nearest konbini) for Haneda T3 airport delivery, so Tue 29 Dec is bag-free until the airline bag drop; keep the waybills on a phone.

stops.name: Isomaru Suisan Shinjuku 3-chome
stops.plan: 24-hour seafood izakaya: kaisen-don bowls and grill-your-own scallops as the post-cruise hangover breakfast, eaten fast before the bell.
stops.transport: Tokyo Metro Marunouchi Line, Shinjuku-sanchome to Korakuen, about 22 min door to door

stops.name: DDT RING FINALE 2026 at Korakuen Hall
stops.plan: DDT's year-end show in the holy land of Japanese wrestling (doors 10:30, bell 11:30). Tickets are by LOTTERY on e+: apply now for 8 in one application. If the lottery fails, skip this and start Kōenji from late morning (fallback); the B.LEAGUE games (Sunrockers vs Ibaraki, Kawasaki vs Chiba 15:05) are only an alternative until bleague.jp confirms them.
stops.transport: JR Chuo-Sobu Line local, Suidobashi to Koenji (weekend rapids skip Koenji), about 33 min door to door

stops.name: Kōenji gādo-shita izakaya
stops.plan: Late lunch the Kōenji way: cheap yakitori and highballs in the izakaya under the JR tracks, a day-drinking town on a Sunday afternoon.

stops.name: Kōenji vintage crawl (Pal & Look arcades, Kita-Kore Building)
stops.plan: Split into 2–3 crews down Pal and Look arcades, then Kita-Kore Building's punk and archive racks north of the tracks; meet at the station at 18:45 (Sunday shops close about 20:00).
stops.transport: JR Chuo-Sobu Line local, Koenji to Shinjuku, then walk to Tochō, about 21 min

stops.name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building observatory
stops.plan: Free 202 m deck, both sides open today (the north deck shuts 28 Dec and both 29 Dec, so this is the night); then catch the projection-mapping show on the facade outside. Last entry 21:30.
stops.transport: Toei Oedo Line, Tochomae to Shinjuku-nishiguchi, then walk to Kabukicho, about 14 min

stops.name: Shinjuku Kabuki Hall / Kabuki Yokocho (Tokyu Kabukicho Tower)
stops.plan: Dinner at one big shared table: everyone hits a different regional stall, DJs on the stage. Go easy on drinks before the bath. (Umi no Ie's ¥1,480 nomihodai is skipped: it refuses anyone under 20.)

stops.name: Thermae-yu (Kabukicho)
stops.plan: Natural-spring soak, sauna and lounge in the middle of Kabukichō; out well before the 01:00 late-night surcharge. No tattoos.

stops.name: Shinjuku Golden Gai
stops.plan: Split into two groups of 4 and hop the micro-bars that post English prices; Sunday is calmer. Cash for seat charges, then walk home.
